title: Eleven Acres and One Fence
subtitle: 自然保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然保护（环境保护·资源与保护）
meta: 主题语境：自然保护（环境保护·资源与保护）　|　核心词汇：conservation　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conservation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my uncle ① began a conservation of eleven acres nobody had asked him to keep, and he said the beginning was the whole of the work. The ② conservation, meaning the keeping and not the fence, took one winter to plan and stayed planned; conservation, he said, is the only thing on a hillside that is judged by how little is changed.

Every ③ conservation in that valley had the same surveyor, and the ④ conservation at the end, meaning the one he kept for the river and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever funded twice. Conservation, my aunt said, is nine parts surveying and one part somebody willing to leave it alone; my uncle said the leaving alone is the part that fills the winter.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ conservation was the whole of the bill, meaning the saving and not the keeping. The ⑥ conservation, meaning the saving and not any of that, is the only thing in a bill that everybody praises and nobody measures; conservation, she said, is either something you begin or the only word that means both a keeping and a saving. He said the saving is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ conservation had become a line in a grant, and the grant had become an argument about the surveyor. The ⑧ conservation of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in January, was one hillside and thirty years of leaving alone; conservation, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to measure. She said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ conservation I remember is the one at the end, which was funded in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ conservation, my aunt said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being left alone; every conservation, she said, is a saving that has agreed to look like a keeping. She said the saving was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 保护；保存（自然环境的保护）
B. n. 保护（指那种守护本身，与那道围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：begin a conservation 开展一项保护工作
D. n. 保护（指那个山谷里每一项）
E. n. 保护（指末尾那一项）
F. n. 节约；节省（指能源、开支的节约）
G. n. 保护（指拨款文件里提到的那一项）
H. n. 保育；维持（抽象总称）

items.q: began a conservation of eleven acres nobody had asked him to keep
The conservation, meaning the keeping and not the fence
conservation was the whole of the bill
the conservation had become a line in a grant
The conservation of the whole thing
A conservation, my aunt said in 1978

answers.why: begin a conservation 意为“开展一项保护工作”，1962 年叔叔对十一英亩没人要他守护的土地开始了保护。
conservation 意为“保护”，指那种守护本身而不是那道围栏，规划花了一个冬天。
conservation 指那个山谷里每一项保护工作，每一项都是同一位测绘员做的。
conservation 指末尾那一项（他留给河流的那一项），是唯一有人资助过两次的。
conservation 意为“节约、节省”，母亲说节约就是那张账单的全部，指的是节省而不是守护。
conservation 为另一个义项，指那种节省而不是守护，是账单里人人称赞、却无人计量的东西。
conservation 意为“保护”，指拨款文件里提到的那一项，到 1970 年这项保护成了拨款文件里的一行。
conservation 意为“保育、维持”，叔叔一月写道，整件事的保育是一片山坡三十年的不打扰。
conservation 意为“保护”，我记得的是末尾那一项，1976 年获得资助，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
conservation 为抽象总称，姑姑说一项保护是唯一会因为被不打扰而变好的东西。
